corpus: Mei et al. 2025, A Survey of Context Engineering for Large Language Models, arXiv 2507.13334
corpus_note: Facts are drawn from the survey's prose (introduction through conclusion, roughly the first third of the extracted text); the remainder of the extracted text is the bibliography of over 1400 cited papers.

questions.question: According to the survey's abstract, how many research papers does the survey analyze?
According to the survey, what maximum context window does LongRoPE achieve, and how (in how many stages)?
questions.gold_answer: LongRoPE achieves 2048K tokens (about 2 million tokens), via a two-stage approach: fine-tune to 256K length, then positional interpolation to the maximum length
questions.section_hint: Section 4, Position Interpolation and Context Extension (page ~18)

questions.question: According to the survey, what percentage improvement does GPT-4 achieve through iterative self-refinement (the Self-Refine method)?
According to the GAIA benchmark results cited in the survey's evaluation section, what accuracy do humans achieve on general assistant tasks, and what accuracy do advanced models like GPT-4 achieve?
questions.gold_answer: humans achieve 92% accuracy; GPT-4 (advanced models) achieve only 15% accuracy

questions.question: According to the survey's conclusion, what are the four categories of System Implementations?
questions.gold_answer: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Memory Systems, Tool-Integrated Reasoning, and Multi-Agent Systems
